verdict.rationale:
Clerk exposes a documented OpenAPI/Backend API (clerk-probe-3), session-token backend auth (clerk-docs-6), webhooks, migration via Backend API (clerk-docs-7), and org/role/permission management that mirrors the UI (clerk-docs-3,4,24), suggesting broad API parity with the dashboard/UI experience. However, there is no explicit vendor claim of full UI-to-API parity, and community feedback flags gaps like RBAC limitations and reliability issues that suggest not every UI capability is cleanly API-accessible (clerk-comm-3).
missing for 10: explicit parity documentation/statement, evidence that billing/impersonation/admin-dashboard actions are fully API-driven, independent confirmation of complete feature parity.
